federations.name: International Boxing Association
federations.note: AIBA renamed IBA in December 2021. IOC suspended recognition in 2019 (Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024 boxing run by an IOC unit) and withdrew it in June 2023. Not the Olympic governing body from 2019.

federations.name: World Boxing
federations.note: Founded April 2023; IOC provisional recognition February 2025; boxing confirmed for LA 2028 (March 2025) under World Boxing. Distinct organisation from IBA (not a rename).

federations.name: World Rowing
federations.note: Founded 1892 as FISA; brand "World Rowing" adopted in 2008 (FISA remains the legal name).

federations.name: United World Wrestling
federations.note: FILA renamed United World Wrestling (UWW) in September 2014.

federations.name: World Aquatics
federations.note: FINA (founded 1908) renamed World Aquatics in December 2022.

federations.name: World Athletics
federations.note: IAAF (founded 1912) rebranded World Athletics in 2019; "International Amateur Athletic Federation" until 2001.

federations.name: World Sailing
federations.note: ISAF renamed World Sailing in 2015 (earlier IYRU until 1996).

federations.name: World Taekwondo
federations.note: World Taekwondo Federation (founded 1973) renamed World Taekwondo in 2017.

federations.name: Badminton World Federation
federations.note: International Badminton Federation (founded 1934) renamed BWF in 2006.

federations.name: World Baseball Softball Confederation
federations.note: Formed 2013 by the merger of IBAF (baseball) and ISF (softball).
